title: Not bad for what you are paying - easy to install
text:
Not bad for what you are paying - easy to install. This is a decent set of floating shelf that you can install wherever really, but I put them in my guest bathroom to gain some extra storage. The 2 shelves have a different laminated coating on them, both look like fake marble, one is black and the other white marble. I admit it isn't the fanciest looking marble but these are also not very expensive shelves.

The shelves are easy to install. On one of them you can also install a towel holder which is a nice little thoughtful addition and very helpful in the bathroom.

This is a real nice inexpensive way to add extra storage in your bathroom or any other room really since these are nice little floating shelves. The price is pretty inexpensive really and appropriate for what you get.
